snippet.title: Rainbow Legends | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: In a world sustained by living colors, territory is power and hue is life. When the Void Lord began devouring all color, the land fell into chaos and balance shattered. To resist extinction, warriors learned to fight not with damage, but with color itself—claiming ground, shaping battlefields, and defending their cores through tactical cardplay. In this ever-shifting conflict, only those who master color and strategy can reclaim the spectrum and seal the Void once and for all.
